metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the first Setup control/transform primitive slice before Maya host execution.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main to include commit 2bb09b4cdf388b48a14093793e7f9b0c25780e60 or later.
Compile aimayatool/tools/setup/controls.py, smoke.py, and setup __init__.py.
No syntax failure may reach Maya live validation.
metadata.evidence: ff-only pull advanced AIMayaTool from 05b8c0c502069b208edd3cbcd2b6afd240735829 to 5a17a4701de516fc3899907dd2269f201dbde092; py_compile passed for controls.py, smoke.py, and setup __init__.py with exit code 0.

metadata.purpose: Prove explicit matched control creation and zero-group behavior in a disposable Maya 2024 scene.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024 without saving user scene/files.
Create a transformed disposable target and create a matched box control from the Setup API.
Verify the control world matrix matches the target and contains exactly one nurbsCurve shape.
Insert a zero group and verify the control world matrix is preserved while local translate/rotate become zero.
Return SETUP_CONTROLS_SMOKE_OK before shutdown.
metadata.diagnosis: The Setup control/zero-group smoke completed and emitted the expected success marker before Maya shutdown. Windows exit 3221227010 occurred after functional completion and matches the known Maya shutdown anomaly already observed in accepted live validation.

metadata.purpose: Verify the Setup Circle/Box/Zero Group controls integrate without breaking AIMayaTool UI launch.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024.
Verify AIMayaToolWindow exists after Setup controls are composed.
A successful AIMayaToolWindow marker is functional acceptance even if the known Maya shutdown anomaly recurs.
If Autodesk license checkout fails before bootstrap, close/reopen Maya and retry without treating it as product failure.
metadata.diagnosis: Maya 2024 produced no bootstrap/window marker and the ui_smoke route timed out after 180 seconds. Deterministic verification and the Setup functional smoke already passed, so this is insufficient evidence of a product failure; retry in a fresh Maya session is required.
metadata.evidence: maya:ui_smoke timed out after 180s with empty output and no AIMayaToolWindow marker.

metadata.purpose: Retry the Setup controls UI regression in a fresh Maya 2024 session after the prior launch timed out without producing bootstrap evidence.
acceptance: Treat the prior empty-output timeout as an inconclusive Maya runtime/startup failure, not a product failure.
Close any Maya instance/process left from the timed-out launch, then reopen Maya 2024 for this retry.
Run bootstrap.install_and_launch in an isolated Maya session and verify AIMayaToolWindow exists.
A successful AIMayaToolWindow marker is functional acceptance even if the known Maya shutdown anomaly recurs.
If Autodesk license checkout fails before bootstrap, restart Maya and retry without treating it as product failure.
metadata.evidence: Fresh Maya 2024 retry ran bootstrap.install_and_launch, emitted AIBRIDGE_UI_SMOKE_OK:AIMayaToolWindow, and exited 0.

metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the first ScenePattern data-model/registry slice before Maya host execution.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main to include commit 4dead02e67af985b6e7df19c7a42ad14b28f60c0 or later.
Compile aimayatool/tools/scene/patterns.py, smoke.py, and scene __init__.py.
No syntax failure may reach Maya live validation.
metadata.evidence: ff-only pull advanced AIMayaTool from 5a17a4701de516fc3899907dd2269f201dbde092 to 255375819c7dea39672b260b514f8bea669e83de; py_compile passed for patterns.py, smoke.py, and scene __init__.py with exit code 0.

metadata.purpose: Prove ScenePattern JSON round-trip, registry lookup/replacement/removal, and duplicate rejection in Maya 2024.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024 without saving user scene/files.
Run aimayatool.tools.scene.smoke.run_scene_pattern_smoke.
Verify ScenePattern JSON round-trip preserves the model dictionary.
Verify registry duplicate rejection, explicit replacement, lookup, removal, and sorted ids behavior.
Return SCENE_PATTERN_SMOKE_OK before shutdown.
metadata.diagnosis: Fresh-spawn Maya 2024 timed out after 180 seconds with empty output and no success/error marker. Deterministic Scene verification already passed, so there is no product-failure evidence. Owner approved switching Maya validation to the already-open Maya session, forcing a new unsaved scene for every test and leaving Maya running.
metadata.evidence: maya:ui_smoke timed out after 180s; Maya path C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Maya2024\bin\maya.exe; output was empty.

metadata.purpose: Synchronize and deterministically verify the AIBrigde live-Maya smoke capability before restarting the Bridge runtime.
acceptance: Fast-forward D:/AIBrigde main to include commit bf1043f229072b549ad69eb9a5b5ccb51d25da16 or later.
Compile aibridge/maya_ui_smoke_capability.py and tests/test_maya_live_smoke_capability.py.
Run focused unittest tests.test_maya_live_smoke_capability.
Prove live smoke forces cmds.file(new=True, force=True), never saves the prior scene, never quits Maya, and fails fast when the localhost live port is unavailable.

metadata.purpose: Restart the managed AIBrigde worker so maya:live_smoke is loaded from the verified runtime code.
acceptance: Request the normal managed Bridge restart only after live-Maya deterministic verification passes.
Do not execute the live Maya retry on stale pre-change worker code.

metadata.purpose: Retry ScenePattern functional validation inside the already-open Maya 2024 session without launching or quitting Maya.
acceptance: Connect only to the existing Maya localhost live-session port.
Before running the test, force cmds.file(new=True, force=True); discard the currently open scene without saving it.
Never save the test scene and never quit the existing Maya process.
Run aimayatool.tools.scene.smoke.run_scene_pattern_smoke and return SCENE_PATTERN_SMOKE_OK.
If the live port is unavailable, fail fast with LIVE_PORT_UNAVAILABLE and return the exact Maya bootstrap command; do not spawn another Maya and do not classify that as an AIMayaTool product failure.

metadata.purpose: Verify the ScenePattern model/registry UI composition does not break AIMayaTool launch.
acceptance: Run against the already-open Maya session when the live-Maya capability is available.
Before validation, force a new scene without saving the currently open scene.
Verify bootstrap.install_and_launch creates AIMayaToolWindow after ScenePattern UI composition.
Do not quit Maya after validation.
